Name: Hell on Earth
Text: HIT - If you have a weapon in your energy pile and your rival has more than 3 cards in his hand, he discards down to 3 cards in hand.

Name: Ice Clone
Text: If your rival's first attack in his next action hits, his action ends when that attack finishes. (*) If used by Sub-Zero, discard the top card of your rival's deck.

Name: Khan's Commander
Text: You may remove any cards in your discard pile.

Name: Kneecap Strike
Text: If played as the 3rd attack or higher in a combo, this attack does +2 damage.

Name: Shattering Kick
Text: HIT - This attack copies the "HIT - " text on 1 attack in your energy pile if that attack puts cards into your deck.

Name: Swinging Sweep
Text: When any effects from attacks in this combo put cards into your deck, you may increase the amount by +2.

Name: Take All Comers
Text: This attack does +1 damage for each card in your hand.

Name: Telekinetic Trip
Text: Your rival must pay +1 energy before he can block this attack.

Name: The Sounds of Music
Text: While in your energy pile, your rival must pay 1 energy before he can block your 0 cost projectiles.

Name: Thigh Cut
Text: Your rival's events cost +1 energy this step.

Name: Tiger Tail Kick
Text: HIT - The "HIT -" text of your next attack in this combo is used when you play that attack instead.

Name: Under Cut
Text: If this attack is blocked, put a card from your discard pile into your energy pile.

Name: Hat Trick
Text: If you have a projectile in your energy pile, your rival discards a card from his hand.

Name: Protective Teleport
Text: If you have a punch in your energy pile, you may pay 1 energy to set an event from your discard pile.

Name: Wrist Reflect
Text: If this blocks a punch, the punch goes to the discard pile after it finishes.
